text:
olivia: DeployBot just flagged an SBOM issue for redwood/infra:rc-2026.1 — cosign signature missing on the base image. We're in the final change window, cutover in ~2h. Legal/regulatory wants an evidence window for EU customers if we proceed. Options: stall full cutover, do a staggered EU-only canary, or pin to last-signed base image. @jen @tara @mike :eyes:

deploybot: [SBOM-SCAN] image=redwood/infra:rc-2026.1
issue=cosign-signature-missing
severity=medium
action=canary-quarantine
run_id=deploybot-9853
logs:
```
SBOM check: provenance: MISSING_SIGNER
cosign verification: failed (no signature attached)
recommended: do not proceed without verification or pin to signed digest
```

mike: If we want to keep momentum, we can pin the deployment to the previous signed digest (sha256:7c9e...) for global traffic and schedule a targeted EU canary with extra audit hooks. Patch looks like: `kubectl set image deploy/infra infra=redwood/infra@sha256:7c9e... --record`

tara: Security viewpoint: pinning is safest for global. For EU-specific staged rollout, we need to ensure provenance export + immutability of logs. If we do a canary, enable KV-cache disabling for that pool so cache artifacts are revalidated. Also add an alert if cosign is still missing after rollout.

jen: Legal: We can accept a limited EU canary if the following are satisfied before traffic hits EU customers: 1) export SBOM + cosign metadata to our audit S3 bucket, 2) retention policy set to 180 days for evidence, 3) KMS/HSM usage recorded for any signing operations. Otherwise we must stall full rollout until artifact provenance is provided. I can fast-track an exception if deploy plan includes these items.

lucas: QA: We can run an EU-only 5% canary in ~30m if feature-flag + rollback toggle exist. We'll need the canary job to run the full integration smoke suite and snapshot logs to the evidence bucket. Rollback window should be automated to <15m.

sophie: Product: Customers in EU might see a delayed feature flag flip. Need a short line in release notes & support playbook in case customers ask. Prefers staged rollout vs global stall.

olivia: Ok decision: do a staggered EU 5% canary with full evidence export & retention + pin the global rollout to the last-signed digest for non-EU traffic. Hold full cutover globally until legal confirms evidence artifacts are present. I'll create a short RFC ticket and tag legal for final sign-off. :white_check_mark:

deploybot: Action queued:
- pin global deployment to redwood/infra@sha256:7c9e... (task 4521)
- schedule EU 5% canary with provenance export (task 4522)
status: queued by olivia
eta: EU canary start ~30m

mike: On it, prepping K8s patch and feature-flag gating.

lucas: I'll schedule the smoke run and the rollback automation.

jen: Reviewing the evidence steps now, will confirm within 45m.

sophie: I'll draft the release note blurb and support FAQ.

olivia: Thanks everyone — keep updates here. If legal signs off earlier, we'll proceed to staged promote. Otherwise hold until evidence is in the audit bucket. :thumbsup:
